name: Daisy
style: Water tempo · patient setup and daring reversals

dialogue.intro: Oh, you're the new challenger? You were staring at the wrong side of the card, cariño. The interesting part is what I do next. I'm Daisy.
dialogue.repeat: There you are. Are we playing cards, trading rumors, or pretending we didn't plan to run into each other?
dialogue.flirt: If that's your opening move, I'm curious what you've been saving for the late game.
dialogue.duelWin: Okay, that was good. I was trying not to look impressed. Clearly failed.
dialogue.duelLose: That grin? Keep it. I earned this one.
talk: A sheer skirt and a secret strategy have something in common: everyone thinks they've seen the whole thing.
I like the café after sunset. The windows make everyone look like the main character in a music video.
No, I don't dress for duels. I dress for myself. Winning just matches the outfit.
My tattoos? The lotus is about growing through things. The three stars are for people who saw me before I knew how.
People hear a joke and think you aren't serious. Let them. Then show them the score.
When I want to disappear, it's oversized hoodie, baggy trousers and headphones. Total incognito mode.
There's this half-second before someone draws the last Prize where I can hear the whole room go quiet.
I can admit I was wrong. I just prefer to do it with a dramatic entrance.
If I look confident, it means I decided not to wait for permission.
My glasses aren't a disguise. They just make it easier to stare at a tiny card and pretend I'm studying.
When I'm testing a deck, I take notes on the turns that felt clever and the ones that only looked clever in my head.
People expect confidence to mean I never second-guess myself. It mostly means I keep moving while I do.
I'll change a whole outfit over one awkward seam. If it pulls when I sit, it isn't finished.
A camera can catch a good angle. It can't tell you whether I felt like myself in the room.
I like being noticed when I chose the moment. Being watched without a say in it is different.
The lotus tattoo is the part people ask about first. The story behind it belongs to me, so sometimes I just say, 'I liked the design.'
The three little stars remind me who showed up when I was still figuring myself out. That's the short version.
I test risky cards with a plain-looking deck box. It's fun watching people underestimate the list before turn two.
Sometimes I dress like I expect the room to notice. Sometimes I wear the biggest hoodie I own and hope it doesn't.
Your shuffle is getting better. Careful, if I keep complimenting you, you'll start thinking I enjoy tutoring you.
I can pose for a photo and still say no to a picture I don't want taken. Those things aren't opposites.
The best styling choice is the one you stop thinking about once you leave the mirror.
hangouts: Daisy holds two translucent skirt layers against the window and asks which moves better when she walks.
You browse the arcade together. Daisy critiques the neon lighting with alarming precision.
At the café, Daisy draws a flower on your napkin and explains why she likes things that grow crooked.
You test a new deck at the card shop while Daisy makes outrageous predictions and keeps an honest score.
The two of you walk through the park after a summer rain; Daisy trades jokes for a rare quiet moment.
Daisy tries on an enormous hoodie for a low-key day and laughs when you almost don't recognize her.

appearance.silhouette: Adult Argentine woman, 20 years old, 167 cm, feminine and curvy with natural proportions, defined waist and soft hips. Long dark hair with straight bangs and half-up ponytail.
appearance.palette: Near-black hair, warm olive skin, deep brown eyes, vivid raspberry lipstick, black lace, burgundy translucent mesh, pink highlights and silver jewelry.
appearance.hair: Long glossy near-black hair, neat full fringe, usually half-up ponytail, loose lengths reaching waist.
appearance.eyes: Large expressive almond-shaped warm dark-brown eyes, crisp cat-eye black liner, dark upper lashes, delicate lower lashes and softly arched brows.
appearance.details: Small nostril hoop, silver ear hoops; detailed floral and cartoon cat tattoos along arms and shoulders, three small stars near upper chest, crucial central lotus/flower tattoo between breasts with delicate stem continuing down the sternum, additional ornamental under-bust tattoo.
appearance.expressions: Teasing half-lidded look, knowing smirk, open genuine smile, playful wink, sudden wide-eyed surprise, flustered sidelong glance, focused competitive stare and guarded tenderness.
outfits: Signature: burgundy sheer long-sleeved top over opaque bralette, layered black translucent mini skirt over secure shorts/lining, black boots.
Evening: black lace transparent long-sleeved top over opaque black underlayer with matching lined sheer skirt and ankle boots.
Summer: thin translucent blouse with opaque underpinning, light flowing sheer skirt over visible lining, optional sunglasses.
Only when sporty or hiding: dramatically oversized baggy hoodie and very loose trousers; never fitted sporty/cargo pants in routine outfits.
appearance.renderNotes: Approved Neo Campus polished modern anime/JRPG cel shading, mature adult face consistent with image references. Daisy always uses sheer/translucent tops with opaque underlayers and usually lined translucent skirts; sporty exception is deliberately huge baggy clothes. Preserve brown eye shape, straight bangs, central flower sternum tattoo, three stars, arm sleeves, piercings. Transparent portrait and cut-in PNG with no background; event CGs landscape scene background. No wardrobe cargo pants.
